description: This PHP source file defines the WeeklyTimesheetPeriod class, which extends the TimesheetPeriod class, and manages weekly timesheet periods including calculation of relevant dates and timezone handling within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: WeeklyTimesheetPeriod
classes.description: Represents a weekly timesheet period, with methods to calculate the days within the period, set period details, and handle timezone adjustments.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the dates within the weekly timesheet for a given current date, based on the start date from XML.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Returns an XML string defining the timesheet period and its start date.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Maps a timezone offset to a timezone name; returns false if no match is found.
